sources.normalizedText:
SYNTHETIC BUILDERS WEEKEND — OFFICIAL RULES
The event runs 2031-06-07 10:00 UTC to 2031-06-08 16:00 UTC.
Pre-existing code is allowed. Teams should describe what they built during the event.
Judging uses short stage presentations of three minutes per team.
